cae_papers.title: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
cae_papers.summary_en: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues.
cae_papers.summary_zh: 英文摘要：Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. cae_papers.title: Three-Photon Bayesian Imaging of Ortho-Positronium
cae_papers.summary_en: PET provides functional images relying on two-photon coincidences from positron-electron annihilation.
